heroHeadline: Dormant since July, India's 'Cockroach' movement re-mobilizes: CJP calls a September 5 return march after the government breaks three of four settlement promises
heroSubtitle: The Cockroach Janta Party says only Dharmendra Pradhan's resignation has been honored from its July 25 settlement — compensation for NEET suicide victims' families, withdrawal of FIRs against protesters, and a police apology remain unmet — and on Aug 24 called a September 5 march from India Gate to Delhi Police headquarters led by victims' families; Delhi Police say no permission has been sought and are staging paramilitary units around India Gate under standing prohibitory orders, even as the state-level exam-protest fronts in Jharkhand and Bihar stay comparatively quieter after their Aug 17 and Aug 27 government concessions.
footerNote: Data sourced from official reports, major outlets, and institutional analyses.
